item.title: ✏️ Fall college testing season is here in Arlington ISD! Students and families, here are…
item.description:
✏️ Fall college testing season is here in Arlington ISD! Students and families, here are two important testing dates to add to your calendar:
📆 Sept. 30 | ACT School Day 📆 Oct. 7 | PSAT Testing • PSAT 8/9: Designed for 8th graders • PSAT 10: Designed for 10th graders • PSAT/NMSQT: Taken by 10th and 11th graders, with 11th graders eligible for National Merit Scholarship consideration
Students, get a good night’s sleep, arrive at school on time, and come ready to show what you know! Want to Practice? > https://satsuite.collegeboard.org/practice satsuite.collegeboard.org/practice

item.title: 🥁 The bands are back! The 44th annual Dean Corey Marching Band Extravaganza is coming to…
item.description:
🥁 The bands are back! The 44th annual Dean Corey Marching Band Extravaganza is coming to the new Glaspie Field at Martin High School! All six Arlington ISD high school marching bands will take the field, plus a special performance from UTA’s marching band.
📆 Monday, Sept. 28 ⌚ 7 p.m. 📍 Glaspie Field at Martin High School 🎟️ FREE admission 🥫 Arlington ISD Fine Arts will also host a canned food drive benefiting Mission Arlington, so bring a few cans and help support our community.
Dean Corey Marching Band Extravaganza set for Sept. 28:https://bit.ly/4xWO6Lh
